title: cpcut: shape-preserving C2 cut-offs of the Casimir-Polder potential for quantum-reflection simulations
description:
Python package and scripts that reproduce every number and figure of Z. R. Yahya and M. N. A. Halif, Shape-preserving C2 cut-off of the Casimir-Polder potential for quantum-reflection simulations of Bose-Einstein condensates (submitted to Computer Physics Communications).

The package builds truncated Casimir-Polder potentials (hard cut-off, C1 parabola, C1 cubic, C2 polynomial quintic and the monotone C2 rational quintic transition), computes the spurious reflection each causes with a stationary scattering solver, and includes a one-dimensional time-dependent Gross-Pitaevskii solver (split-step Fourier with complex absorbing potentials). Result files of all runs reported in the paper are included.
